description: Offline leg-fact warehouse synthetic AIDX subset. Flight scheduling, path optimization and booking elements are explicitly out of scope.

FlightLeg.OperatingCarrier: operating carrier code (authoritative sender's carrier identity)
FlightLeg.Suffix: optional flight suffix (missing element => empty suffix)
FlightLeg.ServiceDate: local operating day YYYY-MM-DD, independent of message/receipt date

ScheduledTime.comment: ScheduledTimeOffBlocks (departure) / ScheduledTimeOnBlocks (arrival), explicit UTC offset required

gate_field.comment: Gate present with empty/NONE code or nil='true' is an explicit clear. Absent element = no update.

message_envelope.EventID: globally unique message id; identical retransmission folds, differing payload conflicts
message_envelope.SourceRevision: positive integer; ordering only within the same sender
message_envelope.IdentityAt: ISO-8601 with explicit UTC offset; selects the alias interval binding the operating key
message_envelope.Sender: authority identity; unknown senders are quarantined as external evidence

unsupported_elements.policy: record each occurrence with xpath/line and quarantine the whole message payload from fact projection; the message itself is retained

notes: Timestamps without an explicit UTC offset are rejected, never assumed local.
Missing optional element means 'no update'; nil/empty marker means 'explicit clear'.
Scheduled/estimated/actual times are separate fact fields and never overwrite one another.
No element outside this profile is interpreted, even if the XML is well-formed.
